question: ______ is a discipline of science that studies the origin and eventual fate of the universe.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cosmology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Cosmology is the scientific study of the large-scale properties of the universe as a whole.
 
• It endeavors to use the scientific method to understand the origin, evolution, and ultimate fate of the entire universe.
